create_Dataset_for_finetuning: create a Dataset instance to load JSONL training data with negative context sampling for retrieval finetuning
create_DatasetKD_for_distillation: create a DatasetKD instance to load knowledge distillation data with context passages and gold scores
create_Collator_for_batching: create a Collator to tokenize and batch queries with gold and negative passage tokens for training
create_CollatorKD_for_distillation_batch: create a CollatorKD to tokenize questions and passages with gold scores for knowledge distillation training
use_load_data_to_parse_jsonl: use load_data to parse a JSONL or JSON file into a list of examples with ranked contexts
